kind: code — created early to carry a Phase-3 gate binding; full rows authored when the phase is reached.

MUST: conductor_dispatch_wave performs PLAN_REVIEWED->EXECUTING, which legalRunTransition gates on survivingMajors===0 || round>=max. dispatch_wave fires from PERSISTED state (Run has planReviewRounds, NOT survivingMajors). It MUST supply satisfying context: if planReviewRounds < planReviewMaxRounds the review exited CLEAN (survivingMajors was 0) -> pass survivingMajors:0; else pass {round:planReviewRounds, max:planReviewMaxRounds} (cap exit). The gate is satisfiable-by-construction because you only reach PLAN_REVIEWED by satisfying the exit condition (§3.2 line 1125). Without this, a clean plan-review livelocks entry to EXECUTING.
